title: Pan-Seared Pork Chops with Ethiopian Spice
description: A fusion of Japanese and Ethiopian flavors, this dish brings a unique twist to traditional pork chops.
instructions: Season the pork chops with Ethiopian spice and let it sit for 10 minutes.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Sear the pork chops for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 10-12 minutes or until cooked through.
In a small saucepan, combine sake and sugar. Bring to a boil over medium heat and reduce to a glaze.
Brush the glaze over the pork chops during the last 2 minutes of cooking.
Let the pork chops rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
Garnish with chopped green onions and serve immediately.
